title.narrative: Strengthening HIV response in communities and linkages to the public system - Mozambique (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Mozambique, HIV, Fundação para o Desenvolvimento da Comunidade (FDC)This program has the following goals: Reduce new HIV infections 25% by 2025. Reduce HIV-related deaths 30% by 2025. Reduce the estimated percentage of child HIV infections from HIV-positive women delivering in the past 12 months to <5% by 2025. The objectives of this program are: Increase the percentage of PLHIV who know their status to 95% by 2025.. Increase coverage of PLHIV on ART to 90% by 2025.. Reduce the percentage of AGYW involved in risky behaviors 10% by 2025.
